mapper.insert: INSERT INTO defense_student_questions (defense_id, question_id, custom_question, question_type, sort, created_at) VALUES (#{defenseId}, #{questionId}, #{customQuestion}, #{questionType}, #{sort}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(MAX(sort), 0) + 1 FROM defense_student_questions WHERE defense_id = #{defenseId}
SELECT sq_id, defense_id, question_id, custom_question, custom_standard_answer, question_type, sort, created_at FROM defense_student_questions WHERE defense_id = #{defenseId} ORDER BY sort ASC
